pages.text: A collapse leaves a crater inside a much larger $(danger)dark energy zone$(). It never fades on its own.$(br2)It's dangerous, but it's also the only source of several rare materials.

pages.title: Size and border
pages.text: A reactor holding the ignition minimum of mass leaves a zone $(num)500$() blocks in radius. More mass, bigger zone: $(num)4x$() the mass doubles the radius, from $(num)150$() up to $(num)2,000$() blocks.$(br2)It's a sphere centered on the $(thing)bottom of the crater$(), so even when it shrinks it still takes in the crater floor and its ore. Its edge is a black wall you can see from far away. It bursts outward from the crater behind a violet shock front the moment the core collapses.

pages.title: Inside
pages.text: Inside, the world looks like it's seen from within a black hole: the view swirls and bends.$(br2)$(thing)Gravity is weak$(): everything falls at $(num)40%$() speed, jumps higher and takes less fall damage. Mobs float too, and so do $(thing)Sable$() contraptions.

pages.title: Fallout
pages.text: The $(thing)fallout$() is the part within $(num)500$() blocks of the crater: corrupted ground, ore nodes and corrupted mobs.$(br2)A big collapse's zone reaches much further than that, but beyond the fallout it's only low gravity and the warped view. A zone smaller than $(num)500$() is fallout all the way to its wall.

pages.title: Corrupted ground
pages.text: Bare ground turns to $(item)Corrupted Stone$() a few blocks deep, outward from the crater to $(num)500$() blocks. The zone loads its own chunks, so all of it turns. Plants die off.$(br2)Trees, water and anything you built are left alone.

pages.title: Corrupted mobs
pages.text: Hostile mobs born within $(num)500$() blocks of the crater are $(danger)corrupted$(): twice the health, harder hits, faster, armored, trailing purple sparks.$(br2)They drop $(item)Void Dust$(), and rarely a $(item)Graviton Core$().

pages.title: Drifters
pages.text: Jellyfish of dark matter that float through every zone. They never attack, but hit one and it $(thing)pulses$(): everything nearby floats up off its feet for a moment.$(br2)They drop $(item)Void Dust$().

pages.title: Lensing Stalkers
pages.text: Tall shapes that bend light, in the fallout. While anyone looks their way they $(thing)can't move$(); look away and they rush you.$(br2)Straight on you can barely see one: watch the edges of your view.

pages.title: Echo of the Core
pages.text: The final fight. Once only one node is left, go down to the crater floor and the ghost of the reactor rises to meet you. It replays its failures: a $(thing)shockwave$() (jump it), a $(thing)pull$() and a $(thing)beam$() (step out of its red line).

pages.title: Beating the Echo
pages.text: Before the last node it can't be hurt. It hits harder below half health.$(br2)Beaten, it drops a random $(l:operation/research)Recording$(), an $(item)Event Horizon Fragment$() and a $(item)Graviton Core$(), and the zone falls in on itself and is gone.$(br2)It doesn't leave: if you fall, it's still waiting when you come back.

pages.title: Unstable ore
pages.text: Nodes of $(item)Unstable Dark Ore$() dot the corrupted ground, thickest on the crater floor. Mining one gives $(item)Dark Matter Shards$() (sometimes $(item)Unstable Dark Residue$() too), but about one in four $(danger)discharges$(): it hurts, but breaks nothing.

pages.title: The crater
pages.text: Once the crater stops falling in, a few glowing $(item)Singularity Glass$() and $(item)Event Horizon Fragments$() are left at the bottom. They never despawn.$(br2)Singularity Glass is what $(l:operation/research)captures$() a black hole.

pages.title: Closing a zone
pages.text: Use a $(item)Charged Dark Matter Crystal$() on an ore node inside the zone: the node turns to stone and the wall glides inward.$(br2)A zone has $(num)8$() nodes. The $(danger)last one$() won't take a crystal: it's the Echo of the Core's.

pages.title: Config
pages.text: Server owners can change the zone's size and limits, the gravity, the node count, the ore and discharge chances, and turn corrupted mobs off.$(br2)With collapse block damage off, the ground is never corrupted.
